scripts.dev: bun run codegen:assets && bun run gen-fixtures && bunx --bun vite --port 5273 --strictPort --open /examples/index.html
scripts.build: bun run codegen:assets && bunx --bun vite build --config vite.config.lib.ts && bun run build:standalone
scripts.build:standalone: bunx --bun vite build --config vite.config.standalone.ts && bun run scripts/check-standalone.ts
scripts.build:examples: bun run codegen:assets && bun run gen-fixtures && bunx --bun vite build --config vite.config.examples.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run codegen:assets && bun run gen-fixtures && bunx --bun vite build --config vite.config.examples.ts --mode production
scripts.demo: bun run build:examples && bunx --bun vite preview --config vite.config.examples.ts --open /examples/index.html
scripts.e2e:serve: bun run codegen:assets && bun run gen-fixtures && bunx --bun vite --port 5273 --strictPort
scripts.e2e:serve:bundle: bun run codegen:assets && bun run gen-fixtures && bunx --bun vite build --config vite.config.e2e.ts --logLevel warn && bunx vite preview --config vite.config.e2e.ts --configLoader runner
scripts.coverage:check: bun ../../.github/scripts/lcov-to-summary.ts coverage/lcov.info --title "niivue test coverage" --sources src --exclude 'src/testing/**' --exclude src/assets/fonts/index.ts --exclude src/assets/matcaps/index.ts --min-lines 43 --min-functions 57
scripts.coverage:merge: bun ../../.github/scripts/coverage-merge.ts --bun coverage/lcov.info --e2e coverage-e2e/lcov.info --out coverage-merged/lcov.info --sources src --exclude 'src/testing/**' --exclude src/assets/fonts/index.ts --exclude src/assets/matcaps/index.ts
